game_concept: A tower defense set in Mystic Forest – Owl Roost, a night-time owl roost: the wood elf archer must handle bog toads while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Range Runner: Run a for i in range(n) loop so the wood elf archer moves exactly n steps toward the spirit shrine.
theme: Mystic Forest – Owl Roost: a night-time owl roost
core_gameplay_loop: In Owl Roost, repeat each round: Run a for i in range(n) loop so the wood elf archer moves exactly n steps toward the spirit shrine. Each round, bog toads strike the spirit shrine, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the steps_left value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the spirit shrine from bog toads in Owl Roost: keep the steps_left meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 63-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: steps_left drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 63-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 6 (applied tier): Range Runner
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Range Runner' (Week 5 slot 1), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Owl Roost'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how steps_left changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against bog toads in Owl Roost.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 63 seconds while steps_left > 0.
